overview_description.description: WorkRamp is an enterprise learning cloud for employee training and customer education at top companies like Reddit, Lattice, Intercom, and Workiva. The company is committed to transforming the future of work by delivering an unparalleled, digital learning experience for employees and customers. With WorkRamp, users feel empowered to learn, collaborate, and develop their skills in a digital workspace that bridges physical and virtual training. Achieve your learning objectives with the Learning Cloud, voted by both admins and learners as most implementable, easiest to use, and easiest setup.

product.name: WorkRamp LMS
product.description: A cloud-based learning management system that supports employee, customer, and partner training with AI-powered features for content creation, personalized learning paths, and integration with enterprise tools.

product.name: Employee Learning Cloud
product.description: A suite of tools including an LMS and content management system to develop, train, and retain employees while ensuring compliance and improving productivity.

product.name: Customer Learning Cloud
product.description: A platform for scalable customer and partner training that enhances product adoption and reduces churn through education and community engagement.

product.name: WorkRamp AI
product.description: An AI-powered toolset that assists in creating, delivering, and managing learning content by automating content generation, brainstorming, and enhancement.

product.name: Slack LMS Integration
product.description: An LMS designed to operate within Slack, enabling onboarding, training, and development with notifications and coaching delivered directly through Slack channels.
